selected_geometry_sources.classification: External boundary geometry; reconciled to the electoral registry; not IEBC-issued
selected_geometry_sources.taxonomy_caveat: The dataset is titled "Administrative Wards in Kenya 1450" but is attached to geographies recorded as geography_system = electoral. A 1,450-ward dataset is in practice the County Assembly Wards, but that lineage is NOT stated by the publisher and has not been confirmed. Until it is, treat the attachment as an unverified equivalence between an administrative ward layer and the electoral ward registry. This is the exact hazard the geography_system column exists to make visible. Open item: confirm with the American Red Cross or IEBC whether this layer derives from IEBC CAW boundaries.

Ward table contains 1,448 records; rejected as canonical ward geometry.

rejected_or_cross_check_sources.licence_caveat: The repackaging repository ships an MIT LICENSE file. MIT covers the repository CODE. The underlying data is OpenStreetMap-derived and carries ODbL regardless; a downstream repackager cannot relicense OSM data. Nothing published depends on this package, and it is retained only as a rejected cross-check. If any OSM-derived geometry is ever promoted, ODbL attribution and share-alike obligations attach and the layer must be kept separately licensed.

publication_rule: Publish ward geometry only as externally sourced and reconciled; publish county, constituency and country geometry only as dissolved from wards. Do not label any of it official-direct or imply IEBC endorsement. Preserve file and geometry hashes, match methods, applied corrections and reference divergences.

boundary_version_policy.basis: First boundary review, concluded 2012, in force from the 2013 general election: 47 counties, 290 constituencies, 1,450 County Assembly Wards.
boundary_version_policy.next_era_expected: After the August 2027 general election. IEBC announced a phased approach in January 2026 and confirmed no constituency or ward boundaries change before the poll.
boundary_version_policy.rule: boundary_version records the legal delimitation era. Geometry provenance is recorded separately in geometry_source_id and geometry_revision, so replacing coordinates never implies a boundary change.
